scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man arranges smooth stones on a low wooden table while speaking to a woman who listens across from him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the arranged stones and the spoken answer to reflect Proverbs 16:1: a person prepares the heart, while the answer of the tongue comes from Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler in robes walks along a sunlit hillside path; nearby, a golden balance stands in a shaft of light with a white wisp curling above one pan.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 16:2: a person's ways seem pure in his own eyes, while Yahweh weighs the spirits.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A craftsperson raises open hands in prayer beside a wooden workbench covered with tools and shavings. A path winds through cultivated fields toward a village beneath a bright morning sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a craftsperson entrusting his work to Yahweh; the firm table and path suggest thoughts being established.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man clutching a purse walks away from an overturned market stall as its seller reaches toward him. Beyond them, sheep graze in a sunlit valley near a village, while a dark rainstorm gathers over the road.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 16:4: Yahweh has made all for Himself, and even the wicked face a day of doom.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two richly dressed men clasp hands on stone steps in an ancient town, with crowns at their feet; a judge holding balanced scales and several townspeople watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of proud allies facing judgment illustrates Proverbs 16:5 and its warning that joining forces will not leave the proud unpunished.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling traveler reaches toward a small pouch offered by a man while another man holds his hand to help him rise. A dark, thorn-lined path lies behind him, and a sunlit path leads toward an ancient village and olive trees.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests mercy and truth, reconciliation, and a reverent turning away from evil in Proverbs 16:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men in ancient-style clothing extend open hands toward one another on a sunlit stone path among olive trees, with a shield and spear resting against rocks and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of reconciliation reflects Proverbs 16:7: when a person’s ways please the LORD, He makes even that person’s enemies be at peace with him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a grain seller weighs grain for a woman while, behind them, a wealthy merchant turns away a pleading man beside a tilted scale and heaps of grain and coins.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene contrasts an honest exchange with abundant wealth accompanied by injustice, reflecting Proverbs 16:8.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler traces a curved line in the dust with a stick at a fork in a rocky hillside path. A sunlit road winds through trees toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 16:9: the traveler's tracing suggests a planned way, while the sunlit path evokes Yahweh directing his steps.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king seated in a sunlit stone court extends an open hand toward a man and woman standing before him; a guard stands behind the throne.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative court scene reflecting the verse’s concern with a king’s speech and faithfulness in judgment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a merchant and customer look at a level balance holding grain in one pan and a stone weight in the other. An open cloth bag of stone weights rests on the counter.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects Proverbs 16:11 and its image of honest scales and the weights in the bag belonging to the Lord.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king sits on a stone throne in a sunlit royal court, raising one hand as a petitioner speaks and a richly dressed courtier offers a purse; guards stand behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative royal hearing evokes the proverb’s contrast between wickedness and the righteousness that establishes a throne.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A simply dressed counselor gestures as he speaks to a smiling crowned king seated on a decorated throne in a sunlit stone courtyard, with guards standing behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative court scene illustrates the king delighting in a person who speaks what is right, as described in Proverbs 16:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in purple robes sits scowling on a golden throne as a man in a head covering gestures toward him with open hands. Two armed attendants stand behind them in a sunlit royal court.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 16:14, showing a wise man appealing to an angry king as attendants suggest the danger of the king's wrath.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling crowned king reaches from a sunlit stone terrace toward a man looking up at him, while rain falls from a dark cloud over green fields and a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating the king's favorable face to life and his favor to a cloud of latter rain in Proverbs 16:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner listens to an older teacher pointing to the roots of a plant. An open chest of gold and a bowl of silver coins sit beside them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the choice to gain wisdom and understanding as more valuable than gold and silver, echoing Proverbs 16:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a walking staff turns away from a rocky, thorn-filled path onto a sunlit stone road winding toward a village among trees and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of turning from a dangerous path and carefully keeping to a safer way, reflecting Proverbs 16:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man walks with his chin raised along a high stone path as the edge crumbles beneath his leading foot, overlooking a sunlit hillside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb that pride precedes destruction and a haughty spirit precedes a fall.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A simply dressed group shares bread and a meal beneath a tree in a sunlit village, while richly dressed figures divide golden vessels and jewelry on a raised terrace behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts humble companionship with the lowly and the division of spoil among the proud in Proverbs 16:19.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks with an attentive, smiling younger man beneath a tree and grapevine. Fruit, flowers, stone houses and a winding path fill a sunlit hillside landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of attentive listening and quiet happiness evokes the verse's connection between heeding the word, finding good, and trusting in Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling elder gestures as he speaks to adults and children gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard; one child examines a small plant, and a bowl of honey rests on a low table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates the verse's wise heart and sweet speech to a teacher whose gentle words encourage learning.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler kneels to drink from a spring and guides its flowing water toward a young plant. Nearby, two villagers spill water from a broken clay vessel in a sunlit village landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting understanding as a wellspring of life and the folly associated with fools in Proverbs 16:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand over his heart and the other extended as he speaks to a group listening beneath leafy trees and vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the wise heart guiding speech and adding learning to the lips in Proverbs 16:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder offers encouraging words to a younger man beside a bowl of honeycomb in a sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The verb and noun cues follow OSHB morphology. The scene illustrates the comparison in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling traveler walks along a sunlit, flower-lined path through olive trees; ahead, the path follows a crumbling cliff above a deep, shadowed ravine.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 16:25, depicting a path that appears appealing but leads toward danger and death.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A laborer in light linen cuts golden grain with a sickle beside an empty woven basket and a clay jug. Harvested sheaves, a village, and hills fill the sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene evokes the laborer's hunger driving him to work in Proverbs 16:26.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man crouches beside a dug pit, holding tangled thorn roots with a shovel nearby. A symbolic flame emerges from his mouth as he speaks toward a worried man and woman. Olive trees, stone buildings and hills fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 16:27: the unearthed thorns suggest digging up evil, and the flame represents words like burning fire.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers into the ear of a frowning man while another man stands apart with his hands open. Olive branches frame the scene, with village buildings and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 16:28's warning that a whisperer can stir strife and separate close friends.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside, a man in a red robe touches a hesitant neighbor’s shoulder and gestures toward a dark ravine path, while a sunlit village lies behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the violent man enticing his neighbor and leading him in a way that is not good in Proverbs 16:29.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a winking man with pursed lips tips a basket of grain onto the ground while a nearby seller looks away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relates the man's wink and pursed lips to the verse's warning about devising and bringing about evil.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A silver-haired elderly woman offers a loaf of bread to a seated man beside a sunlit stone path, with olive trees, village houses, and distant hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects silver hair with honor and a compassionate act along a path with the way of righteousness in Proverbs 16:31.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A calm man raises an open hand toward an angry neighbor on a sunlit stone path; soldiers stand near a walled city in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts patient self-control with military might, reflecting Proverbs 16:32.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man seated beneath a tree lets small stones fall onto the fold of cloth spread across his lap, with sunlit hills, trees, and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the lot cast into the lap in Proverbs 16:33; the verse says every decision comes from Yahweh.
